variables.name: color/content/on-brand
variables.description: RETIRED 2026-10-05 — superseded by the content/on-fill family (brand/primary/content/on-fill, status/*/content/on-fill). Do not bind new nodes to this. Remaining references are documentation and playground pages only.

variables.name: color/brand/primary/content/on-fill
variables.description: White label/icon on a filled brand primary surface (contained button, filled chip). 3.50:1 on brand/primary/on-surface/default.

variables.name: color/brand/secondary/content/on-fill
variables.description: PENDING CONTRAST FIX — currently white to match today's rendering. Dark label/icon on a filled brand secondary surface would be 4.77:1 vs 3.74:1 for white. Unused today (no contained/secondary variant).

variables.name: color/status/error/content/on-fill
variables.description: White label/icon on a filled error surface. 4.83:1 — passes AA.

variables.name: color/status/success/content/on-fill
variables.description: White label/icon on a filled success surface. 5.48:1 — passes AA.

variables.name: color/status/info/content/on-fill
variables.description: White label/icon on a filled info surface. 4.10:1 on info/on-surface/default.

variables.name: color/status/warning/content/on-fill
variables.description: PENDING CONTRAST FIX — currently white to match today's rendering. Dark label/icon on a filled warning surface. White fails at 3.19:1; this is 5.60:1.

variables.name: color/status/active/content/on-fill
variables.description: PENDING CONTRAST FIX — currently white to match today's rendering. Dark label/icon on a filled active surface. White fails badly at 1.74:1; this is 10.25:1.
